g.text: Joint versus LLM traveler agents: pre-existing gaps and trip-scope differences
Positive differences mean greater time cost. Dashed horizontal segments: phase means.
The runs differ before Joint pricing; these contrasts do not identify the causal effect of adding the Manager.
